tables.name: scans
tables.comment: Observed state: sequenced, not in entity_log, never tombstoned.

fields.name: folder_id
fields.comment: scope. NULL: the whole source

fields.name: mode
fields.comment: 0 rescan folders, 1 rescan files, 2 failed read

fields.name: started_at
fields.comment: unix ms

fields.name: finished_at
fields.comment: unix ms. NULL: running or interrupted

tables.name: pending_changes
tables.comment: Changed files (same location, new hash) waiting for a choice.

fields.name: file_id
fields.comment: → files.id, already pointing to the new image

fields.name: old_image_id
fields.comment: → images.id, the image before the change

fields.name: decision
fields.comment: NULL open, 0 values follow, 1 new picture

fields.name: root_url
fields.comment: folder paths are relative to it: a relink is one write

fields.name: excludes
fields.comment: JSON list of relative paths removed from the project

fields.name: metadata
fields.comment: JSON, read once at open

tables.name: folders
tables.comment: Name + parent, not a path: a move is one row.

fields.name: parent
fields.comment: → folders.id. NULL: the source's root folder

fields.name: name
fields.comment: '' for the root

fields.name: status
fields.comment: 0 present, 1 missing. Subfolders and files are missing too

fields.name: status_scan_id
fields.comment: → scans.id

tables.name: files
tables.comment: A location. Points to one image.

fields.name: folder_id
fields.comment: → folders.id

fields.name: image_id
fields.comment: → images.id

fields.name: size
fields.comment: size and mtime as of the last hash

fields.name: mtime
fields.comment: unix ms

fields.name: created_at
fields.comment: unix ms, when a scan added it

fields.name: status
fields.comment: 0 present, 1 missing. Also missing if a parent folder is

fields.name: status_scan_id
fields.comment: → scans.id, the scan or failed read that set the status

fields.name: added_scan_id
fields.comment: → scans.id, the scan that found it as new

tables.name: images
tables.comment: Content: identical bytes. Created by scans.

fields.name: hash
fields.comment: first byte names the hash algorithm, then the digest

fields.name: size
fields.comment: bytes

tables.name: image_values
tables.comment: Live rows only. STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID.

fields.name: image_id
fields.comment: → images.id

fields.name: value
fields.comment: ANY in the real schema: native INTEGER | REAL | TEXT, never JSON

tables.name: instances
tables.comment: A sample of the user's study. Created by a data import only.

fields.name: key
fields.comment: the user's id, one key space per project

fields.name: image_id
fields.comment: → images.id, the truth. NULL: never resolved

fields.name: file_id
fields.comment: → files.id, a location hint

tables.name: instance_values
tables.comment: Live rows only. STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID.

fields.name: value
fields.comment: ANY in the real schema: native INTEGER | REAL | TEXT, never JSON

tables.name: subimages
tables.comment: A rectangle of an image, owned by a namespace. Written through commits (logged), unlike images.

fields.name: image_id
fields.comment: → images.id

fields.name: namespace_id
fields.comment: → properties.id, the namespace (dtype 'namespace')

fields.name: x0
fields.comment: 0..1 in the EXIF-rotated frame of the image

tables.name: subimage_values
tables.comment: Live rows only. STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID.

fields.name: subimage_id
fields.comment: → subimages.id

fields.name: value
fields.comment: ANY in the real schema: native INTEGER | REAL | TEXT, never JSON

fields.name: subimage_id
fields.comment: → subimages.id

tables.name: properties
tables.comment: Result of entity_log, like tags and property_groups. No commit_id: the last commit is read from entity_log.

fields.name: dtype
fields.comment: 'namespace' for a namespace: its value on an image is the list of its subimages, derived from subimages. 'box' for boxes: a JSON array per cell

fields.name: mode
fields.comment: 'image', 'instance' or 'subimage'

fields.name: namespace_id
fields.comment: → properties.id. Set: a 'subimage' property of that namespace only

fields.name: parents
fields.comment: JSON array of tag ids

tables.name: commits
tables.comment: Who and when. What a commit changed is in entity_log.

fields.name: group_id
fields.comment: commits undone and redone as one

fields.name: source
fields.comment: who wrote it: ui, import, scan, review, relink, or plugin:<name>

fields.name: timestamp
fields.comment: unix ms

fields.name: active
fields.comment: 0 once undone

fields.name: redoable
fields.comment: 1 while an undone commit can be redone; a new commit clears it

fields.name: undoable
fields.comment: 0 once it named a row deleted for good (purge, instance, file source)

tables.name: entity_log
tables.comment: The one history table: one row per entity a commit changed. Result tables are its replay over active commits. WITHOUT ROWID.

fields.name: table_id
fields.comment: the table ids of the tombstones (01 §3, table ids)

fields.name: k1
fields.comment: key in the table's key order

fields.name: k2
fields.comment: 0: not part of this key

fields.name: k3
fields.comment: tag_id for the tag tables (4, 5, 7), else 0

fields.name: commit_id
fields.comment: → commits.id

fields.name: op
fields.comment: 1 create, 2 update, 3 delete

fields.name: value
fields.comment: value tables (1, 2, 6): the value as in *_values. NULL otherwise

fields.name: changes
fields.comment: other entities: JSON object of the fields set. NULL for values and tags

tables.name: tombstones
tables.comment: Deletions, for delta sync. table_id names the source table, k1..k3 its key. Deleted at project open.

fields.name: rowid
fields.comment: implicit SQLite rowid, shown for drawDB

fields.name: k2
fields.comment: 0: not part of the key

fields.name: k3
fields.comment: 0: not part of the key

tables.name: sequence
tables.comment: One row: the last sequence handed out

fields.name: rowid
fields.comment: implicit SQLite rowid, shown for drawDB
